papers.title: Toward the clinical application of long-read sequencing in repeat-expansion disorders
Distinguishing different psychiatric disorders using DDx-PRS
Variation in the costs and ecological benefits of tropical natural forest regeneration
papers.abstract: Large areas of the tropics could naturally regenerate into forest, yet how the costs and benefits of realizing this potential vary spatially remain unknown. This study fills that gap, revealing that natural regeneration could reduce extinction risk for forest species by ~31% with adequate investment.
papers.titleZh: 熱帶天然森林更新的成本與生態效益之空間變異
papers.summaryZh: 熱帶地區有大面積的土地具備自然更新為森林的潛力，然而過去對於實現此潛力的成本與效益在空間上的變異程度仍屬未知。本研究填補了此一知識缺口，揭示在獲得充分投資的情況下，自然更新可將森林物種的滅絕風險降低約 31%。這項研究釐清了相關成本與效益的空間分布，對於評估熱帶森林的保育與恢復潛力具有重要意義。

papers.title: Regulatory CD8+ T lymphocytes control intestinal inflammation
papers.abstract: A population of intramucosal GPR15-guided regulatory CD8+ T cells control intestinal inflammation by inducing cell death in inflammatory macrophages.
papers.titleZh: 調節性 CD8+ T 細胞控制腸道發炎
papers.summaryZh: 本研究指出，一群位於黏膜內的 GPR15 引導之調節性 CD8+ T 細胞（regulatory CD8+ T cells），能透過誘導發炎性巨噬細胞（inflammatory macrophages）細胞死亡來控制腸道發炎。此發現揭示了調節性 CD8+ T 細胞在調控腸道發炎反應中的重要機制。

papers.title: Progenitor T cells drive chronic pulmonary type 2 inflammation
papers.abstract: Here, Brennan and colleagues report that chronic type 2 inflammation drives the differentiation of progenitor-like T helper 2 cells, distinct from acute and resting memory cells and with the capacity to sustain lung inflammation in the face of ongoing antigen exposure.
papers.titleZh: 前驅T細胞驅動慢性肺部第二型發炎反應
papers.summaryZh: Brennan 等人研究發現，慢性第二型發炎反應會驅使 T 輔助細胞 2 (Th2) 分化為類似前驅細胞的狀態。這群前驅樣 Th2 細胞與急性發炎期及靜止期記憶細胞不同，具備獨特特性。在持續抗原暴露下，這些細胞能維持肺部發炎反應。這項研究有助於理解慢性肺部發炎中 T 細胞反應的維持機制。

papers.title: Social interactions between people of same and different generations shape longitudinal changes in interpersonal neural synchrony, loneliness, and social connection
papers.abstract: Loneliness is globally acknowledged as a severe and burgeoning health risk, fueling interest in helping people of all ages form meaningful social connections. One promising approach consists of intergenerational social programs. While behavioral and qualitative evidence derived from such programs promise health and wellbeing benefits, the physiological consequences of repeated intergenerational encounters remain unknown. Insight into physiological changes will shed light on the mechanisms of social connection. We charted longitudinal changes in interpersonal neural synchrony (INS) in 31 intergenerational (older/younger adult) and 30 same-generation (younger adult) dyads across a six-session creative drawing program. At each session, dyads completed self-report measures, drew together and alone, and had their cortical activation recorded with fNIRS. In both groups, INS was greater while dyads drew together than alone. Across sessions, intergenerational dyads’ INS decreased and same-generation dyads’ INS increased. INS in RIFG~RTPJ and RIFG~RIFG were predictive of loneliness levels and feelings of social closeness, respectively. This exploratory longitudinal research reinforces the multi-faceted nature of INS dynamics as social connections are forged.
papers.titleZh: 世代相同與不同者之間的社交互動，會形塑人際神經同步性、孤獨感與社會連結的縱向變化
papers.summaryZh: 本研究探討了跨世代與同世代社交互動對人際神經同步性（interpersonal neural synchrony, INS）、孤獨感及社會連結的縱向變化之影響。研究人員透過為期六次的創意繪畫課程，記錄了跨世代與同世代雙人組的 cortical activation 與自我報告量試。結果顯示，兩組在共同繪畫時的 INS 皆大於單獨繪畫時，且跨世代組的 INS 隨會話增加而下降，同世代組則上升。此外，特定腦區間的 INS 分別能預測孤獨感水平與社會親密感。這項探索性研究突顯了在建立社會連結時，INS 動態的多面向特性。

papers.title: BART-spatial unravels biologically significant transcriptional regulators from spatial omics data
papers.abstract: Transcriptional regulators (TRs) are crucial regulators of cell fate decisions by activating or repressing lineage-specific genes and integrating environmental signals with intrinsic networks. Identifying functional TRs is essential for understanding development, tissue organization, and disease. Emerging spatial transcriptomics and epigenomics technologies now provide near-single-cell resolution mapping of genomic features while preserving information of each cell's physical location and microenvironment which influence TR activity. Despite these advances, identifying active TRs in spatial data remains challenging due to low TR expression and the fact that TR activity often does not correlate directly with mRNA levels. Moreover, existing tools mainly designed for non-spatial single-cell data overlook spatial heterogeneity. To bridge this gap, we developed BART-spatial (Binding Analysis for Regulation of Transcription for spatial omics data), an innovative computational method to infer functional TRs from spatial omics data. BART-spatial integrates spatial variability and pseudotemporal information with publicly available TR binding profiles. Applied to multiple spatial datasets from diverse platforms, including 10x Visium, Visium HD, Atera, and spatial RNA-ATAC-seq, BART-spatial consistently outperforms existing methods, identifying state-specific TRs and revealing regulators undetectable by expression alone. Its compatibility with spatial epigenomics data further strengthens its utility and enables cross-validation. Overall, BART-spatial provides a powerful and robust tool for decoding spatially resolved gene regulatory programs.
papers.titleZh: BART-spatial 解析空間體學數據中具生物意義的轉錄調控因子
papers.summaryZh: 轉錄調控因子（TRs）對細胞命運決定至關重要，但由於其表現量偏低且活性與 mRNA 表現量未必相關，從空間體學數據中鑑定功能性 TRs 一直是個挑戰。本研究開發了 BART-spatial 這套創新的計算方法，結合空間變異性與擬時間資訊，並整合公開的 TR 結合圖譜，來推估空間數據中的功能性 TRs。該工具適用於 10x Visium、Visium HD、Atera 及空間 RNA-ATAC-seq 等多種平台，表現優於既有方法，能找出狀態特異性的 TRs 以及單靠表現量無法偵測到的調控因子。BART-spatial 亦相容於空間表觀體學數據，有助於跨資料驗證並解碼空間解析的基因調控程式。

papers.title: BoYueGRN: Zero-shot causal discovery of directed gene regulatory networks from single-cell transcriptomes via amortized inference over synthetic structural causal models
papers.abstract: Gene regulatory network (GRN) inference from single-cell RNA-seq conventionally relies on per-dataset optimization. Existing tools must be refit for every new dataset, and the majority fail to infer causal regulatory directions. Here we present BoYueGRN, an amortized causal discovery framework trained exclusively on 10,000 synthetic structural causal models. For any unseen dataset, a single forward pass returns edge probabilities and regulatory directions, while TF-centric sliding windows with asymmetric fusion extend this fixed-size model to full-transcriptome coverage. BoYueGRN demonstrates strong zero-shot performance across BEELINE benchmarks. On two independent genome-wide CRISPRi Perturb-seq screens, directional accuracy on retained edges reaches 0.86 and 0.95. Reconstructed cell-type- and stage-specific GRN dynamics across five diseases spanning more than 270,000 cells yield experimentally testable biological hypotheses. BoYueGRN reframes directed GRN inference as a train-once, reuse-across-datasets paradigm. By decoupling network reconstruction from per-dataset optimization, this paradigm opens the door to systematic, atlas-scale mapping of regulatory dynamics across human diseases.
papers.titleZh: BoYueGRN：基於合成結構因果模型的攤銷推理，零樣本發現單細胞有向基因調控網路
papers.summaryZh: BoYueGRN 是一個攤銷式因果發現框架，僅以一萬個合成結構因果模型進行訓練。對於任何未見過的單細胞 RNA-seq 資料集，單次前向傳遞即可輸出邊機率與調控方向，並透過以轉錄因子為中心的滑動視窗與非對稱融合機制，將固定大小的模型延伸至全轉錄體規模。在 BEELINE 基準測試中展現強健的零樣本表現，並於兩項獨立的 CRISPRi Perturb-seq 全基因體篩選中，保留邊的方向準確率分別達到 0.86 與 0.95。將此方法應用於橫跨五種疾病、超過 27 萬顆細胞的資料，可重建具細胞類型與發育階段特異性的 GRN 動態，產生可供實驗驗證的生物學假設。

papers.title: RNA velocity in growing cells
papers.abstract: The ultimate promise of single cell "RNA velocity" methods is compelling: in principle, one can project forward the transcriptional state of each cell and map long-term expression trajectories. While there has been robust and ongoing articulation of limitations of existing methods, consensus frameworks fail to account for a fundamental aspect of cellular dynamics: growth. In a growing population, biomass (including RNA and other macromolecules) is constantly accumulating. This implies a homeostatic velocity (defined in the terms of production and degradation) that is positive, which is at odds with the conventional estimation, interpretation, and uses of velocity. Here, we investigate the consequences of omitting cell growth from the RNA velocity framework. We demonstrate systematic errors that arise in simulations of growing cells and show evidence for these artifacts in existing data. Finally, we point the way forward and highlight that explicitly accounting for cell growth can lead to new biological insights.
papers.titleZh: 生長細胞中的 RNA 速度
papers.summaryZh: 本研究指出，現今的單細胞 RNA 速度（RNA velocity）方法與共識框架未能將細胞生長納入考量，忽略了在生長細胞群體中生物質不斷累積所帶來的正向恆定速度。作者透過模擬與現有數據分析，展示了在 RNA 速度框架中省略細胞生長所產生的系統性誤差與偽影。研究最後指出，明確將細胞生長納入計算將有助於引領出新的生物學見解。
